description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio (in percentage) and two metrics—perplexity and GPU memory ratio—across different configurations of the PyramidInfer system. The x-axis, labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)", ranges from 0 to 100 with major tick marks at intervals of 20, representing the proportion of recent sequences in the input. The left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity", spans from 4.2 to 4.7, while the right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", ranges from 40 to 100. The plot includes four distinct lines: "Perplexity" (orange, solid line with circular markers), "Full Cache PPL" (red, dashed line), "GPU Mem. Ratio" (blue, solid line with circular markers), and "Full Cache GPU Mem." (blue, dashed line). The "Perplexity" line starts at approximately 4.6 at a recent sequence ratio of 0%, decreases sharply to about 4.3 at 40%, fluctuates slightly between 4.3 and 4.4 until 80%, and then rises to 4.4 at 100%. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" line begins at around 42% at 0% and steadily increases to 95% at 100%. The "Full Cache PPL" line remains constant at 4.3 across all values of the recent sequence ratio, and the "Full Cache GPU Mem." line remains constant at 60% across all values.
